# wxone_securityGroup (Resource)

Manages a securityGroup.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the securityGroup.
- `project_id` (String) Project id of the securityGroup.
- `rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the securityGroup.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the securityGroup in UUID format.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) Action of the rule.
- `cidr` (String) CIDR of the rule.
- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `direction` (String) Direciton of the rule.
- `ether_type` (String) IP Version of the rule.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `ports` (String) Port List, either single, all, comma separated or a range 1:256 of the rule.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the rule.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the rule.

Optional:

- `protocol_int` (Number) Protocol Number of the rule if protocol is set to int.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the subnet.
